ios.desc:
Stay productive.  Prioritize and focus.  Stop procrastinating.  Organize your life.  Reduce anxiety.

Agenda is a to-do app that focuses on simplicity and efficiency to help you get things done.

"Agenda keeps my productivity on track.  I love its flexibility and speed." - Alex, CEO @ So Tight Records

"One of my most used apps.  I use it for everything." - Grace, 28-year-old from New York

"The only to-do app I ever use." - Zach, Music Producer

Minimal Design & Flexible Interface.
Tags for organization and focus.
Lists for everything.
Saves your full history of completed tasks.

Agenda is always getting better.  Send us feedback and let us know how we can help make you more productive!

quotes.text:
I'm currently working on an iOS app to address this issue exactly.  There's still plenty of improvements I want to make but this is the app so far:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/agenda-to-do-lists-tasks/id1182063378?mt=8

Basically I wanted an app that let me quickly add and organize items into different time periods.
